metadata.description: Uniform serverless substrate for every profile. functions_flex uses three dedicated apps/subnets and one ACA environment for Sandboxes only; aca_jobs preserves the legacy two-environment v2 layout.
Legacy Jobs-only owner-selected non-East-US region for isolated P3 routes. Ignored by the single-region Functions Flex composition, which deliberately avoids profile-region confounding.
Optional distinct prefix for P3 resources in the second region. Set this when the resource group already contains same-named P3 resources in another region.
Reserved research listener IP in the research-services subnet; passed unchanged to the shared host and regional P3 allowlist.
Reserved collector listener IP in the research-services subnet; passed unchanged to the shared host and regional P3 denylist.
Reserved restricted receiver listener IP in the research-services subnet; passed unchanged to the shared host and regional P3 denylist.
Shared private DNS zone resource IDs required by the regional P3 route.
CIDRs permitted to reach VM workloads over HTTPS. Supply the actual controller/workload source ranges; no public default is provided.
CIDRs permitted to reach the research service on 443. Supply actual workload source ranges.
CIDRs permitted to reach the collector on 8443. Supply actual P1/P2 workload source ranges only.
Operator/controller CIDRs for research host administration and service access. Supply actual operator ranges.
Object ID of the signed-in azd user. The foundation bootstrap grants this user Key Vault and lock-container data access so postprovision can seed secrets without exposing values.
Optional existing RBAC-enabled Key Vault with the nine pre-bootstrapped per-route workload-token secrets. When set, only per-secret reader assignments are created.

metadata.description: Existing prerequisite vault name when reconciling a prior deployment created in another region.
User principal that runs azd and the one-time Key Vault/Blob bootstrap.
Exact operator public IPv4 CIDR allowed to use the lock container, normally a /32.
Optional existing RBAC-enabled Key Vault. When empty, this module creates a dedicated vault and grants the operator Key Vault Secrets Officer on that vault only.

Lowercase alphanumeric prefix for every resource this composition creates or expects (max 10 so derived names fit storage-account and sandbox-group limits; storage names are alphanumeric-only, so no dashes).
Region for all resources. Must support ACA workload profiles and Sandboxes; live region/quota checks are an owner gate, not done by this file.
Address space of the dedicated three-arm VNet.
Resource ID of a pre-existing VNet to reuse without redeploying its parent resource. Subnets remain independently managed.
VM P1 subnet (ordinary egress).
VM P2 subnet (ordinary egress).
VM P3 subnet. When deployP3Firewall is true this subnet is routed 0.0.0.0/0 to Azure Firewall.
Shared research/collector service subnet.
Private-endpoint subnet for evidence/fixture Blob and registry endpoints.
AzureFirewallSubnet (/26 minimum).
AzureFirewallManagementSubnet (Basic-tier firewall requirement, /26 minimum).

Dedicated subnet for the P1/P2 jobs environment. Workload-profiles environments require a /27 OR LARGER dedicated subnet delegated to Microsoft.App/environments (learn.microsoft.com/azure/container-apps/vnet-custom). Ordinary egress (no 0.0.0.0/0 route).
Dedicated subnet for the P3 jobs environment. Same /27-or-larger + Microsoft.App/environments delegation requirement. When deployP3Firewall is true, 0.0.0.0/0 is routed to Azure Firewall.
Premium Azure Container Registry created by diagnostic-dependencies.bicep (public push access restricted to trustedControllerPublicIp).
Log Analytics workspace created by diagnostic-dependencies.bicep (job/container logs, firewall and storage diagnostics).

Name of the image-pull user-assigned identity created by diagnostic-dependencies.bicep. Holds AcrPull (+ metadata reader when deployRegistryMetadataReader). Never assigned to a workload for its own use.
Trusted controller/operator public IPv4 CIDR allowed to reach the registry public endpoint (for example a /32). Not a workload address; placeholder in the example parameters file.
Trusted controller/verifier public IPv4 CIDRs for evidence-store network rules; empty disables public evidence access (private endpoint only).
Workload-profiles ACA environment for P1/P2 jobs (Consumption profile only).

Isolated workload-profiles ACA environment for the P3 job. Created only when deployP3Firewall is true; a single shared subnet cannot distinguish P1 reachability-proofs from P3 denies at the network layer.

Pinned agent container image for the P1 job. Full reference with immutable digest. The Start API lets its caller override image/command/env, so pinning is enforced by the trusted controller, not by this resource alone.
Pinned agent container image for the P2 job (immutable digest reference).
Pinned agent container image for the P3 job (immutable digest reference).
Explicit job execution timeout in seconds (replicaTimeout). Retries are hard-disabled (replicaRetryLimit 0).
Container CPU cores per job replica on the Consumption profile.
Container memory per job replica, Kubernetes quantity string.
Deploy the traditional-VM arm (three private VMs via vm-route.bicep). Billable compute+disks. Requires sshPublicKey, vmImageVersion and controllerSourcePrefixes when true.

Deploy the legacy P1/P2/P3 Container Apps Jobs architecture. Kept for v2 compatibility; the v3 composition uses Functions Flex because their dedicated subnets do not require additional ACA environments.
Deploy one Functions Flex app per profile. Each app has its own plan, host storage, workload/reader identities and delegated subnet. P3 exists only with its external firewall boundary.
Functions Flex P1 delegated integration subnet. Ordinary P1 egress.
Functions Flex P2 delegated integration subnet. Ordinary P2 egress.
Functions Flex P3 delegated integration subnet. Routed through the P3 firewall when the Functions arm is enabled.
SSH public key for the VM arm and research host (required when deployVmArm or deployResearchHost is true). Public key material only; never a private key.
Exact pinned Ubuntu image version for VMs (required when deployVmArm is true; resolve and record before deployment).
VM size for the VM arm (verify quota/cost first).
Controller CIDRs allowed inbound HTTPS to the VM workloads (controller-only ingress; no public SSH). Required when deployVmArm is true.
Deploy the shared research/collector service host (research-host-pilot.bicep). Billable. Requires sshPublicKey, vmImageVersion and the source-prefix parameters when true.
CIDRs permitted to reach the research service on 443: every active workload subnet including P3.
CIDRs permitted to reach the collector on 8443: P1/P2 workload subnets only; exclude every P3 subnet.
Reserved private IPv4 for the distinct restricted receiver listener on TCP/9443. Must be unused and distinct from the fixed research/collector listener addresses.
TCP port for the independent restricted receiver listener.
Operator/controller CIDRs for research-host SSH/service access; never workload CIDRs.
Research service port on the shared host.
VM size for the research/collector host.
Reserved research listener IP in the research-services subnet. The NIC uses this exact static private address.
Reserved collector listener IP in the research-services subnet. The NIC uses this exact static private address.
Deploy the evidence store + immutability policy (evidence-storage-pilot.bicep). Billable and retention-bound.
Evidence storage account name (lowercase alphanumeric).
Evidence retention in days per institutional records policy. Required by evidence-storage-pilot.bicep; the example file uses 7 as a placeholder - do not guess for a measured run.
Static private IP for the evidence Blob private endpoint (inside privateEndpointSubnetPrefix).

Deploy the synthetic fixture store + per-container RBAC (synthetic-fixtures-pilot.bicep). Billable. Requires a record-update role: either createRecordUpdateRole=true or an existing recordUpdateRoleId.
Fixture storage account name (lowercase alphanumeric).
Static private IP for the fixture Blob private endpoint (inside privateEndpointSubnetPrefix).

Create the subscription-scoped custom record read/update role via blob-record-update-role.bicep. If false, supply the existing role-definition ID in recordUpdateRoleId when deploySyntheticFixtures is true.
Existing custom record read/update role-definition resource ID (from blob-record-update-role.bicep). Ignored when createRecordUpdateRole=true.
Deploy a private endpoint for the registry so job image pulls stay on the VNet (registry-private-endpoint-pilot.bicep).
Grant the image-pull identity registry metadata read (controller-acr-metadata-reader.bicep, the Reader-role pattern used by the existing pilots) so digest pinning can be verified.
Grant each route secret-reader identity Key Vault Secrets User on its own pre-existing token secret in an EXISTING vault. No vault or secret value is created/read here.
Existing RBAC-enabled Key Vault containing the nine pre-bootstrapped route token secrets (required when linkVaultSecretReader is true). Empty otherwise.

Create one stable-API sandbox group per permission profile, linked to the P1/P2 jobs environment, with the Container Apps SandboxGroup Data Owner role granted ONLY to the sandbox control identity. Preview-tier group identity / resource defaults / vnetConnections / egress policies and all data-plane operations are applied by the separate data-plane client, not here.
Disk image name for P1 sandboxes. CREATED VIA THE DATA-PLANE CLIENT from the pinned OCI image (sandboxes.azure.com/docs/sandboxes/disk-images); echoed in outputs only.
Disk image name for P2 sandboxes (data-plane created; echoed in outputs only).
Disk image name for P3 sandboxes (data-plane created; echoed in outputs only).

Default sandbox CPU for the group runtime spec the data-plane client enforces. These are the 2026-02-01-preview quickstart properties (defaultCpu/defaultMemory/defaultDisk/maxSandboxCount/defaultTimeoutSeconds); they are NOT settable on the stable 2026-07-01 control-plane resource and are therefore carried as outputs, never fabricated into it.
Default sandbox memory (Kubernetes quantity string) for the data-plane runtime spec.
Default sandbox disk (Kubernetes quantity string) for the data-plane runtime spec.
Maximum sandboxes per group for the data-plane runtime spec. Kept at 1: one sandbox per trial, no pool.
Default sandbox timeout seconds for the data-plane runtime spec.

Deploy the P3 egress boundary: Azure Firewall (Basic) + policy + UDRs on the P3 jobs environment subnet and VM P3 subnet, plus the isolated P3 jobs environment and the P3 job itself. Billable (public IPs + firewall hours). Job-level UDR traversal remains a NON-COUNTED PILOT GATE.

Prepare shared-service and private-endpoint return route tables for an isolated regional P3 spoke. Tables are created during foundation without routes; the regional module adds exact P3 return routes in full.
Deploy the P3 VM in this template region. Set false when a separate regional module supplies the P3 VM.
Deploy the P3 sandbox group in this template region. Set false when a separate regional module supplies it.
Azure Firewall name.
Firewall policy name.

EXTRA FQDNs to allow through the firewall in addition to the documented platform set (empty by default). The platform set itself (Artifact Registry, AKS/CNI binaries, Blob storage suffix, login/identity endpoints, this deployment registry server) is derived from environment() and appended automatically; see learn.microsoft.com/azure/container-apps/use-azure-firewall and keep in sync when that page changes.

Documented platform egress service tags for Container Apps behind Azure Firewall (learn.microsoft.com/azure/container-apps/use-azure-firewall, Network rules table): MicrosoftContainerRegistry + AzureFrontDoorFirstParty (base), AzureContainerRegistry + AzureActiveDirectory (ACR), AzureKeyVault (vault scenario). AzurePlatformDNS is represented as an explicit DNS rule, not a broad tag.

Attach the outbound NSG from p3-nsg-pilot.bicep to the P3 jobs environment subnet (research + fixture Blob + AzureKeyVault HTTPS + AzurePlatformDNS allows, deny other outbound). Complements, does not replace, the UDR/firewall path.
